description: A crowd marches down a narrow street in an old-looking city. Young men and women in white kurtas, dhotis and saris walk in front, several holding a large blank white banner on poles and blank placards. Behind them, a line of helmeted police stands in smoke, and shopfronts line the street with signs that look like Bengali script. The style is a dark, painterly oil look, with no visible violence or blood.
